# Tax-Rates.org

> A comprehensive tax information portal providing federal, state, and local tax rates, calculators, and educational resources for individuals and businesses.

Tax-Rates.org aggregates current tax rates across all U.S. jurisdictions, offering interactive calculators for income and property taxes alongside detailed reference tables and filing guidance. The site serves as a centralized resource for understanding progressive tax brackets, payroll taxes, sales taxes, and state-specific tax obligations.

## Key Topics

- Federal Income Tax
- State Income Tax
- Sales Tax
- Property Tax
- Tax Brackets
- Payroll Taxes
- Social Security
- Tax Calculator
- IRS
- 2026 Tax Rates
- State Tax Comparison
- Tax Filing
- Excise Tax
- Use Tax

## Tax Calculators & Tools

- [Income Tax Calculator - Tax-Rates.org](https://www.tax-rates.org/income-tax-calculator): Federal and state income tax estimation tool for 2024-2025 tax year
- [Property Tax Calculator - Tax-Rates.org](https://www.tax-rates.org/property-tax-calculator): Free property tax calculator for state and county rate estimation

## Income Tax Reference Tables

- [The 2026 Federal Income Tax - Tax-Rates.org](https://www.tax-rates.org/federalincometax): 2026 federal income tax brackets, rates, and IRS filing information
- [Income Tax Rates By State 2026 - Tax-Rates.org](https://www.tax-rates.org/taxtables/income-tax-by-state): 2026 state income tax rates, brackets, and marginal tax rate tables
- [Local income tax rates by state](https://www.tax-rates.org/taxtables/local-income-tax-by-state): Local, county, and city income tax rates by state comparison table

## Sales & Consumption Tax Tables

- [Sales Tax Rates By State 2026 - Tax-Rates.org](https://www.tax-rates.org/taxtables/sales-tax-by-state): 2026 state and local sales tax rates comparison by state
- [State Sales Taxes By County, City, and Zip Code](https://www.tax-rates.org/taxtables/local-sales-taxes): Detailed sales tax rates lookup by county, city, and ZIP code
- [Use Tax By State 2026 - Tax-Rates.org](https://www.tax-rates.org/taxtables/use-tax-by-state): 2026 use tax rates by state for online and remote purchases
- [Alcohol, Gasoline, and Cigarette Excise Taxes By State](https://www.tax-rates.org/taxtables/excise-tax-by-state): State excise tax rates on alcohol, gasoline, and cigarettes

## Property Tax Reference

- [Property Tax Rates By State 2026 - Tax-Rates.org](https://www.tax-rates.org/taxtables/property-tax-by-state): 2026 property tax rates and real estate taxation by state
- [Tax Assessors By State - Tax-Rates.org](https://www.tax-rates.org/taxtables/tax-assessors-by-state): Directory of county tax assessors and property appraisal contacts

## Tax Education & Guides

- [Introduction to marginal income tax brackets | Tax-Rates.org](https://www.tax-rates.org/library/marginal-tax-brackets): Beginner's guide explaining progressive tax system and marginal brackets
- [How To Pay Estimated Income Taxes | Tax-Rates.org](https://www.tax-rates.org/library/estimated-income-taxes): Guide to quarterly estimated tax payments for self-employed individuals
- [How To E-File Your Tax Return | Tax-Rates.org](https://www.tax-rates.org/library/how-to-efile-your-tax-return): How-to guide for electronically filing federal tax returns with IRS
- [What is the 2012 Social Security Tax Rate? | Tax-Rates.org](https://www.tax-rates.org/library/social-security-tax-rate): Educational article on Social Security and FICA payroll tax rates
- [Frequently Asked Questions – Income Tax | Tax-Rates.org](https://www.tax-rates.org/library/income-tax-faq): FAQ covering withholding, deductions, refunds, audits, and credits

## Core Pages

- [Tax-Rates.org - The Tax Information Portal](https://www.tax-rates.org): Homepage providing access to federal, state, and local tax information
